name: Best New Bands (This Feeling)
instructions: Submit your music for review, Track of the Day or Best New Bands playlist consideration (new music only).
notes: UK guitar-band club night/promoter; same site has Apply To Play for gigs.

name: Best Indie Rock and Pop Unsigned (Kevin Graham)
instructions: Submissions: for best results, contact me directly on kegraham@yahoo.com.
notes: Kevin Graham (Kevin ISM, also Radio Wigwam presenter) - different playlist from the existing Wigwam rows; also on Soundplate.

name: Best Undiscovered Indie Rock Radio (Kevin Graham)
instructions: The best Indie and Alt Rock songs from undiscovered artists; submissions: for best results, contact me directly on kegraham@yahoo.com.
notes: Same curator as Best Indie Rock and Pop Unsigned - one email pitch covers both.

name: The Masterplan: The Best British Indie and Rock (Nick Swettenham)
instructions: Experience those epic guitar driven anthems that shaped British Rock and Indie music... blends timeless tracks with some fresh new sounds. Submit a song: submithub.com/direct/nick-swettenham
notes: UK curator (Groover profile 640be2.nick-s, country United Kingdom); mostly classics (Oasis, Radiohead) with some new British indie. SubmitHub premium credits.

name: Ultimate Indie Summer Drive! (Nick Swettenham)
instructions: For lovers of Indie Rock and Summer drives. Melody and uplifting with that feeling of nostalgia. Submit a song: submithub.com/direct/nick-swettenham
notes: Same curator as The Masterplan; one SubmitHub pitch can target several of his lists. Also on Groover.

name: #RickysDailyBangers #GrooverEffect (Ricky Spence)
instructions: I curate a playlist of all my favourite Groover tracks and share this with the aim of getting these tracks heard by new ears.
notes: Playlist description links to his Groover profile ("To Indie and Beyond"); Groover lists United Kingdom; indie rock, alt rock, shoegaze.

name: Live Forever! The Ultimate Indie & Alternative Playlist (Nick Swettenham)
instructions: Discover the new Indie and Alternative artists of today, all on one epic playlist! Submit a song: submithub.com/direct/nick-swettenham
notes: Third Nick Swettenham list; classics plus new indie/alt.

name: SAD INDIE (Tom High)
instructions: Suggest me to me songs to add via https://www.submithub.com/to/tom-high
notes: Groover profile 0.tom-high lists United Kingdom; slow, sad songs only - pitch a ballad. He also runs Indie Roadtrip (upbeat indie/alt) per Groover.

name: UKI (Kevin Mann)
instructions: Please do not send any explicit lyrics or swear words... Also please can you only contact me once the track is released.
notes: UK Independent radio show (Mixcloud) and playlist, since 2017; Groover is the route found.

name: Alternative Modern Rock (Matt's Playlists)
instructions: I'm looking for Modern Rock/ Pop / Genre blending tracks.
notes: Spotify owner "Mathieu Btn"; Groover lists United Kingdom but the name suggests France - country unsure. Big list of established alt/modern rock.

name: New Manchester Music (Audio North / The Manc)
instructions: Drop us a line below and someone will get back to you within 24 hours.
notes: Audio North is The Manc's music section; this is the general contact form, not a music submission form. Playlist covers 'Manchester and beyond'.

name: british indie (Alto Key)
instructions: Looking for well produced indie music with real heart. Prefers songs mixing pop, acoustic and electro elements together.
notes: UK artist-curator (Groover country United Kingdom); list is 2020s UK pop/indie (Tom Odell, Holly Humberstone) - softer than FloodLines.

name: New Original Rock (Keep It Rock)
instructions: A playlist focusing on music releases by new, emerging artists... that we think ROCK and need to be heard - All Originals - No Covers!
notes: UK rock radio DJ/podcaster (Groover country United Kingdom); weekly show also an outlet. Small list.

name: Feel Good INDIE / ALT (Andrew X @ The Atlas Project)
instructions: Sundrenched happy music.
notes: Groover country United Kingdom; says all playlists are supported by daily ads (paid ad growth, not bots, but treat follower count with care).

name: New Music Friday (Existential Magazine)
instructions: Updated weekly with our favourite releases from smaller artists!
notes: UK online magazine (Groover country United Kingdom); also does reviews and monthly roundups.

name: indie alt pop (CATBEAR)
instructions: If we feel a song fits with the style, sound, vibe, we will place the song within the top 23 of the playlist and it will stay for at least a month.
notes: UK band who curate; alt-pop lean, guitar indie a stretch.

name: fresh* (The Sound Lab)
instructions: New Music, New Artists, Future Hits!! A commercial feel with some rock, country and dance elements.
notes: UK radio station/Future Hits show syndicated on many stations; playlist is commercial pop-leaning.

name: BRAND NEW: THE BEST NEW ARTISTS (DMY)
instructions: We support the best emerging artists across UK Rap, Alt Pop, Electronic, R&B, Soul, Jazz and more by approving tracks and adding them to our Spotify playlists.
notes: Playlist description has a SUBMIT MUSIC Groover link; DMY is UK; genres lean rap/alt pop, so guitar indie is a long shot.

name: One Hour Wonder - Independent Music Playlist (Stereo Stickman)
instructions: Relaunched every month for the very best hour of new music the indie scene has to offer.
notes: Only route is paid services (track review $20 and up); the page does not say a review leads to playlisting, and it does not say where the site is based.

name: The Big Indie Playlist (Far Out Magazine)
instructions: Here are all the best new indie and alternative tracks from this week in music.
notes: Weekly feature, guest-curated by a different artist each week; the site's only submissions page is for concert footage, no music route found.

name: new music wins (Friend of the Band)
instructions: If you're interested in being added to the playlist and/or being promoted by us then DM @friend0ftheband, @musicwins1, or @musicstruggles1.
notes: London scene playlist (Windmill bands). A Jan 2024 X post reportedly invites DMs to @friend0ftheband, but X could not be fetched to confirm, so no route is claimed.
